annotations.title: Remove a connected account from the workspace

description: Permanently remove one provider account from the WHOLE workspace — by `connectionId` from fillo_list_connections, or a whole Discord server by `guildId`. Pass exactly one. Every project and form using it loses that destination, stored credentials are deleted, and reconnecting means a fresh OAuth consent (or re-inviting the bot). This cannot be undone from here. `confirm` must be the exact account label from fillo_list_connections, or the Discord server id when removing a server. fillo_list_connections also shows how many forms depend on each. Use the user's explicit authorization for this action and target. Ask if it is missing. Needs integrations:manage.

confirm.description: The exact account label, or the Discord server id for a guildId removal for this irreversible action. Supply it only when the user explicitly authorized this action on this target. Otherwise ask for their decision.

guildId.description: Discord server id to disconnect instead.

name: fillo_remove_connection_account
